hooks.command: prompt=$(jq -r '.tool_input.prompt // ""'); echo "$prompt" | grep -qiE 'build|implement|create|start|scaffold|work on|write' && echo "$prompt" | grep -qiE 'component|page|ui|feature|overlay|modal|nav|layout|screen|frontend|design' && echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: search Mobbin for design patterns before implementing this UI. Use mcp__mobbin__search_screens with relevant search terms (e.g. trade overlay, portfolio list, leaderboard row)."}' || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "Before ending this session: (1) update CLAUDE.md current status section to reflect what was built and what is next, (2) commit and push the update. Do this now, not later."}'
